summary: Cosy 3D tulip garden builder in the Ottoman Tulip Era, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Lale Devri'nde sakin bir 3D lale bahçesi kurma oyunu, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Plant, water and cut tulips on a walled palace terrace by the Bosphorus
Breed hybrids from neighbouring blooms: colour, petal shape and pattern mix the parents'
A bazaar where prices rise and crash, especially during a tulip mania
Build paths, beds, a turtle pool, cypress and plane trees, lanterns and benches; the garden grows each season
30-day seasons end in a festival; win the final one with three stars and at least 20 varieties
